successors.name: Maya city-states (Postclassic)
successors.text: Palenque (Lakamha'), the seat of the B'aakal kingdom near the Usumacinta, Chiapas

ledger.x: 431: K'uk' Bahlam I founds the B'aakal dynasty at Palenque.
799: the last recorded ruler of Palenque.

wars.name: Calakmul's wars on Palenque
wars.outcome: 'Troops from Calakmul invaded and sacked Palenque' in 599 and again in 611 ('A second victory by Calakmul occurred some twelve years later, in 611'); no land is recorded as taken.

wars.name: Toniná's sack of Palenque
wars.outcome: 'In 711, Palenque was sacked by the realm of Toniná' and the old king K'inich K'an Joy Chitam II was taken prisoner and presumably executed.

certainty.note: No frontier is recorded; the radius is the grid's minimum.
